PDF Hardware-Accelerated Frequency Domain Volume Rendering
Abstract Frequency domain volume rendering (FVR) is a volume rendering technique with lower computational complex-ity as compared to other volume rendering techniques. In this paper the original FVR algorithm is significantly accelerated by performing the rendering stage compu-tations on the GPU.
